title: Grushko--Neumann rank additivity for free products
abstract: Formalizes the binary Grushko--Neumann theorem: the minimal number of generators of a free product of two finitely generated groups is the sum of the minimal numbers of generators of the factors. The central theorem is proved by a kernel-checked finite labelled-graph reduction. For a minimal null path, the implemented reduction uniformly performs a source unfold, a subsequent safe fold, and an explicit monochromatic-vertex contraction; this gives the strict decrease used by strong induction and the separated-generator lower bound. The repository also retains the finite-core and free-group rank lemmas from the surrounding development as reusable supporting infrastructure, but only the global Grushko theorem declaration is selected by the public Challenge and Comparator.
authors: Ruy J. G. B. de Queiroz
